title: Backup & Sync REST API (frozen contract, WP-0)

service.gateway_route: /v1/backup/* -> 127.0.0.1:28643 (path kept; the service accepts it with or without the prefix)

auth.jwt: ES256 JWT in Authorization: Bearer or ?token=; every non-GET route also needs the admin role (403 forbidden). Loopback automation (no Origin, no Sec-Fetch-Site, not via the gateway, no X-Forwarded-For) skips the JWT.
auth.token: single-use download token in the path
auth.device: device token (POST /devices, shown once) in Authorization: Bearer only - never ?token=. Accepted ONLY on /devices/:id/* for that device; no JWT and no loopback shortcut there, and a device token is rejected (401) everywhere else. Survives password changes; revoked by POST /devices/:id/revoke (backups kept) or DELETE /devices/:id. Rotated by the server every 30 days: the answer carries the new token in X-NivaroOS-Device-Token and the old one's end in X-NivaroOS-Device-Token-Old-Valid-Until (RFC 3339, 24 h later).
auth.device_or_jwt: either the device's own token (as for device, only for that device) or the owner's admin JWT (403 for a non-admin JWT). A device token is recognised by its shape (nvd_ + 43 characters) and never falls back to the JWT.

shape.data: response_type below, or ErrorBody when success >= 400

types: Go types in services/backup/jobs/apitypes.go and model.go (engine types via aliases). request/response below are the `data` payloads, checked by TestAPIFixtures (strict decode + exact re-encode). 'Empty' is {}.

events.transport: message bus, socket.io path /v2/message_bus/socket.io/, payload {Properties:{...}} (all strings)

endpoints.notes: Install probe for the UI (ui/src/utils/backupInstalled.js, always via the gateway route). Not enveloped, like Download Station's. HEAD is accepted too.
sevenzip: the 7z program encrypted archives need (package 7zip or p7zip-full); the wizard disables "Encrypted archive" without it.

query.role: source|dest (optional; dest hides read-only and preset-only entries)

endpoints.notes: Engine locations plus SMB connections (kind smb), remembered absent USB drives (online:false, last_seen) and app/VM folder presets.
At most 2000 entries (truncated:true beyond).
Used by Files' 'Back up this folder…' and by the migration. ok:false with reason (an error code) when the path can't be an endpoint.
Never carries logs. health is one of problem|offline|warning|ok|disabled.

errors: validation: encryption_secret.password required | out_of_range (8..1024 characters) | invalid (line breaks) | wrong_password (an encrypted backup is already there and this password or recovery key doesn't open it); dest.encryption.mode invalid | sevenzip_missing
endpoints.notes: id, revision, needs_attention, migrated_from, created_at and updated_at are server-owned and ignored. dest.encryption (spec §18): mode "folder" (rclone crypt: contents and names encrypted, file by file; incremental, versions and per-file restore keep working) or "archive" (type archive only: one full 7z per run, AES-256 with encrypted headers, split into volume_bytes volumes, default 3900000000). recovery_key is server-owned. encryption_secret is write-only: the password is stored sealed under the host key and never returned. With make_recovery_key, recovery_key is in this response once and stored nowhere; it unlocks the backup too. When the destination already holds an encrypted backup (its .nivaroos-encryption.json), its salt is reused and the password (or encryption_secret.recovery_key) must open it. dest.encryption can't be changed by PUT (validation dest.encryption invalid): changing the password means a new encrypted backup.
Must send the current revision; the response carries revision+1. A job with needs_attention 'imported' loses the badge on its first update.

query.purge_data: true to also delete the job's folder at the destination, versions included (audited)

errors: invalid_state (a run is active; cancel it first)
endpoints.notes: Without purge_data the response is {}.

Coalesces: when the job already has a queued/running run, that run's id is returned and its coalesced count grows. preview:true queues a kind=preview run. check:true queues a kind=verify run ("Check backup"): copy/mirror compare source and destination (rclone cryptcheck for an encrypted folder; a destination without hashes gets 20 files decrypted in full and the rest compared by size), archive jobs decrypt and read their newest archive through.
Re-adopts the folder at the destination: rewrites its marker with this job's dest_folder_id and clears needs_attention dest_changed. The UI confirms first.
"Test password": whether the password (or the recovery key) unlocks this job's encrypted backup. Compared in constant time; the stored password is never returned.
Never saves. The wizard calls it debounced.
Invalid: valid:false, human_key '', next [], error = the parser message. Server time zone.
Newest first. The installer's update deferral calls GET /runs?status=running,queued on 127.0.0.1:28643 directly (loopback automation, no token).
live is null unless status is running.

lines.raw: ERROR : photos/locked.db: Failed to copy: permission denied

endpoints.notes: Post hooks still run; the run ends cancelled with error_code cancelled_by_user.
proceed:false cancels the run. mode copy_once runs it once as Copy (no deletes). Audited.
Mirror: current then recycle folders newest first. Archive: kind archive entries. Copy: only current.
Runs as a kind=restore run (same run window, locks and notification). target {mode:'other', endpoint:{…}} restores elsewhere. Audited.

No JWT: the single-use token (60 s, bound to the requester IP) is the credential. One file streams raw with Content-Disposition; several paths stream as a zip. 404 when the token is unknown, used or expired (token_invalid).
Audited.
state pending until core's schedules API was reachable.
Idempotent: already imported tasks are skipped_exists.
USB drives any job uses, for Settings > Remembered drives.
Rename (display only).
Backup's side of the IsBusy lock contract, for Scheduled Tasks (spec §8.1).

Enrolled phones, oldest first, for Settings > Devices. Admin only (403 forbidden otherwise), also for GET. Never includes tokens or their hashes. Each device carries its backup summary (last_backup_at, last_status, size_bytes), its folder, dest (null = the default location) and revoked_at.

Admin only. platform: android (default), ios, other. token is a random 256-bit secret shown only in this answer; the server stores its SHA-256. default_dest is /DATA/Backup/<name>, sanitised like companion folders and made unique (<name> (2)); the folder itself is created by the Phase 2 upload endpoints.

errors: dest_offline (purge_data while the drive is missing)
endpoints.notes: Admin only. Removes the phone: its record, every token and its backup index. ?purge_data=1 also deletes its backup folder (409 dest_offline while that drive is missing). Without it the files stay on disk. To keep the backups browsable and only stop the phone, use POST /devices/:id/revoke.

errors: unauthorized (no, wrong, revoked or expired device token, or another device's)
endpoints.notes: For the phone to check its credential. May carry X-NivaroOS-Device-Token (see auth.device): store it at once; if the answer is lost, the next request with the old token (within 24 h) gets another new one.

Admin only. The web UI's phone page: where its backups go (destination: location null = the default /DATA/Backup, online, free space, error_code when unusable), the owner's settings (retention, stale warning), what the phone reports about its own schedule (phone, display only), per-category status, open sessions, a location change in progress (move) and the newest check (last_verify).

Admin only. Absent fields are unchanged. settings: keep_last 1..1000 snapshots, keep_days 0..3650 (newest snapshot of each day), deleted_purge_days 0..3650 (0 = files deleted on the phone are kept for ever), stale_days 0..365 (0 = no warning). Retention is applied at once. name renames the phone and its folder in the same location (refused while a session is open, or while its drive is missing and it has backups).

errors: invalid_state (session open, moving, overlap, target not empty)
endpoints.notes: Admin only. Change location...: location is the folder that will hold the phone's folder (a volume, usb or merge endpoint from the folder picker; null = back to the default). mode move: the backups go along - a rename on the same drive (200), otherwise a background copy (202, detail.move shows progress; the old folder is removed once the copy is complete; a failed or interrupted copy leaves everything where it was and move.state failed). mode fresh: the new place starts empty, the old files stay on disk, the index (snapshots, versions) is dropped; the excluded list stays. mode is required when the phone has backups. Refused while a session is open, when the new folder is inside the current one (or holds it), overlaps another phone's folder or a job's destination, or already exists and is not empty. The new location must be online (a missing drive is refused, never replaced).

Admin only. Stops the phone at once (every token of it: 401 afterwards) and cancels its open sessions. Its backups stay browsable and downloadable; revoked_at is set. POST /devices/:id/token links it again.
Admin only. A new token for the same device (a reinstalled phone, or after a revoke): the old ones stop working, revoked_at is cleared, the backups and their index stay. token is shown only here.
Admin only. Adds content hashes the phone must never upload again (check answers excluded) or removes them. Answers the whole list.

Admin only. ?category=<files category>&path=<file or folder>. Removes the file (or everything below the folder) from the backup, with its versions, and adds its contents to the excluded list so the phone doesn't send them again.

Admin only. A single-use link (GET /downloads/:token, 60 s, same IP) for one file of a snapshot (category + path, snapshot id or latest), one export (export_id), or the complete messages or call log file (full + category sms|calllog, at snapshot).

Admin only. ?category=sms|calllog, body: an SMS Backup & Restore XML file made elsewhere (at most 1 GiB, any Content-Type). Stored as an imported export when it holds messages or calls the backup lacks (result stored), otherwise not stored (result no_new_items).

The phone reads this at every backup start: its device record, where its backups go and whether that is usable now (destination.error_code), the owner's settings, the server limits (chunk size, batch sizes, idle and expiry times) and the categories. See docs/specs/2026-09-30-phone-backup-device-api.md.
The phone reports its own schedule and conditions per category (display only in the web UI; the server never enforces them). reported_at is set by the server.

Starts a backup session: a run of kind device (job_id = the device id) shows in Activity. An open session with the same categories is handed back (200, resumed true). Refused when the destination is missing (dest_offline, never another folder), unusable (dest_marker_mismatch, path_not_allowed), too full for expect_bytes plus the 5 % reserve (507 no_space), being moved, or with 8 sessions open. Sessions idle for 30 minutes end as interrupted. See docs/specs/2026-09-30-phone-backup-device-api.md.

Up to 500 files of one files category (media, files, apks): which to send. Answers per item, in order: have, have_elsewhere (placed from a copy already in the backup, nothing to send), need (upload it; upload_id/offset when an unfinished upload of it exists), need_hash (size or mtime changed, or no sha256: send it again with sha256), excluded, invalid (bad path). 240 checks a minute per phone (429).
Up to 1000 item keys of sms or calllog: new lists the keys the backup lacks. The phone exports only those. Key formula in docs/specs/2026-09-30-phone-backup-device-api.md.

Up to 1000 paths of one files category that are gone from the phone: they stay in the backup, marked deleted_on_device_at (hidden when browsing unless include_deleted). A path that comes back clears its mark.

Ends the session: status success, partial, failed or cancelled; errors (at most 200) become the run's file errors. success/partial makes a snapshot (success with errors becomes partial). Retention runs afterwards. pending_uploads counts unfinished uploads of the session (they stay resumable for 7 days).

tus 1.0 creation. Headers: Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0, Upload-Length, Upload-Metadata (session, category, path or name, sha256, mtime, taken_at, media_id, encrypted; values base64). 201 + Location + Upload-Offset. 200 when nothing is to be sent (status have/excluded) or an unfinished upload of the same file is resumed (status resumed, offset). A 0-byte file is stored at once (status stored). 507 no_space counts every unfinished upload; 413 too_large above 64 GiB; 429 with 64 unfinished uploads.
tus offset: Upload-Offset and Upload-Length headers, no body. 404 when the upload is unknown, finished, expired or void (the location changed).

tus PATCH: Content-Type application/offset+octet-stream, Upload-Offset = the current offset (409 offset_mismatch with the right Upload-Offset otherwise), body at most 8 MiB (413 too_large) and never past Upload-Length. 204 + Upload-Offset. The last chunk checks the SHA-256 (422 checksum_mismatch: the upload is dropped) and places the file; its answer carries X-NivaroOS-Upload-Result: stored, unchanged (an export equal to the newest) or no_new_items (sms/calllog with nothing new). A cut-short body keeps what arrived (400 io_error + Upload-Offset). One PATCH at a time per upload (409 invalid_state). Error answers are enveloped.
tus termination: abandons an upload and frees its space.
Finished sessions (success or partial), newest first, at most 1000: the points in time a phone's backup can be browsed and restored at.

:snap is a snapshot id or latest (the backup as it is now). ?category=media|files|apks&path=<folder>&include_deleted=1. Folders first, then files as they were at that snapshot (version true: an older content than the current one). At most 2000 entries (truncated).

?category=&path=&snapshot=<id|latest>. The file's bytes as they were at the snapshot; Range requests work (206). Headers: ETag and X-NivaroOS-SHA256 (hex), X-NivaroOS-MTime (unix ms). 409 dest_offline while the drive is missing.

?category=<export category>&snapshot=<id|latest>: the exports in effect then - the newest of each full category (and calendar name), every export of sms and calllog. ?all=1 lists every export kept, newest first.
One export file as stored (vCard, iCalendar, SMS Backup & Restore XML, JSON; application/octet-stream when encrypted).

?category=sms|calllog&snapshot=: one SMS Backup & Restore file with every message (or call) of every export up to the snapshot, each once (by item key), oldest export first. Encrypted exports are left out.

?snapshot=<id|latest>&category=<files category, optional>&after=<next_after>&limit=1..5000 (1000). Every file of the snapshot, including ones deleted on the phone (deleted_on_device_at set), ordered by category then path, each with its content path (GET under /v1/backup). The first page of an all-category listing also lists the exports in effect. Continue with ?after=next_after until it is empty.
Content hashes the owner removed from the backup; the phone must not upload them again.

Checks the stored files against the index: missing or wrong size (deep: wrong SHA-256) marks them damaged, and the next check answers need for them so the phone sends them again. deep runs in the background (202, running true; the result lands in GET /devices/:id last_verify and a device-changed event verified).
